search_scope: Repository historical topology grammars plus representative public device classes and designs across tokamak, spherical tokamak, stellarator, field-reversed configuration, mirror, laser inertial confinement, pulsed-power Z-pinch, and representative FRC/stellarator patents. The mapping is a plasma/control-region abstraction and is not an exhaustive prior-art search, patentability opinion, or freedom-to-operate analysis.
mapping_rule: Count physically distinct plasma, loss, driver-target, or formation/confinement regions explicitly described by the source. Hardware component renaming and scalar parameter changes do not create a new mapped region. Candidate and reference are declared non-isomorphic only when mapped vertex counts differ; equal counts remain unknown unless a full typed mapping is available.
